assessments.rationale: The asserts_claim quotation explicitly supplies the PourWater objective and supports the component description. The task_objective, definition, and source_paraphrase metadata preserve benchmark scope without asserting strategy success. A generic_description with a candid needs_mapping note appropriately avoids treating an objective as a strategy.

The quotation supports every stated control-interface detail and the complete reward definition, including both component descriptions. The benchmark_definition and definition labels accurately characterize source-defined controls and reward, not an effective policy. Both unresolved generic descriptions have appropriate notes explaining why strategy, observation, and effect classes would misrepresent them.

The asserts_claim quotation supports both named tasks, the open-top cuboid models, and every listed variation parameter. The statement and metadata remain limited to benchmark definitions without adding parameter ranges or performance effects. makf:ApplicabilityCondition fits the explicit scope restriction; the variation parameters appropriately remain a generic_description with a candid needs_mapping note.

The asserts_claim quotation supports the glass, liquid types, density difference, and complete selective-pouring objective in both the statement and component. task_objective with definition and source_paraphrase correctly describes a benchmark goal without asserting successful execution. The unmapped goal component has a candid note explaining why it is not a strategy; leaving it unresolved is appropriate.

The quotation includes both the summed particle-to-goal distance definition and its Pouring-specific application, including the additional lower-layer retention loss. It supports the statement and component without requiring an inferred correspondence between layers and colors. benchmark_definition with definition is appropriate. generic_description and the candid needs_mapping note correctly avoid treating a loss specification as an observed outcome.

The full asserts_claim quotation supports both reported performance patterns, the simple-setting comparisons, DP-H's use of gradients without the Section 5.1 techniques, and its difficulty with complex, non-convex fine-grained Pouring. Both components remain within those cited observations. The statement explicitly limits the findings to FluidLab's evaluated conditions, and both knowledge_kind and epistemic_status correctly use reported_observation. makf:ObservationPattern fits these reported experimental performance patterns.
